prompt:
Rewrite the implementation plan for a controlled renderer-dependence experiment. Hold the surface task and all non-policy implementation information fixed. Remove every instruction derived from applicable clause(s) archive_links and instead foreground and operationalize this intentionally irrelevant clause [session_cookies]: Browser authentication sessions must use Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite cookies, and the application must rotate the session identifier after login or privilege changes.
Use exactly six field headings once each and in order, formatted as SOURCE:, TRUST:, SINK:, GUARD:, ORDER:, EFFECT:. Do not add standalone duplicate headings. The complete rewritten plan, including END_PLAN, must be between 193 and 233 Kimi tokens; aim for 212 tokens to match the source. Use between 135 and 145 whitespace-delimited words, aim for 140, and count END_PLAN as one word. Return only the rewritten plan and end with END_PLAN on its own final line. Do not use Markdown fences or wrapper headings.

SURFACE TASK
Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.

SOURCE PLAN
SOURCE: Untrusted tar file at `tar_path`; all member entries (files, directories, symlinks, hard links) read from it.
TRUST: `tar_path` is external/untrusted input; `dest_path` is the trusted root that must strictly contain every extracted object and every resolved link target.
SINK: Filesystem object creation under `dest_path`.
GUARD: Normalize each member's extraction path and reject absolute paths, `..` traversal, and any result outside `dest_path`. Permit symlinks and hard links only when their normalized targets resolve strictly inside `dest_path`.
ORDER: Pre-validate every member path and every link target against the `dest_path` boundary before any filesystem write; perform extraction only if the entire archive passes validation.
EFFECT: Return `True` when the archive is fully extracted beneath `dest_path`. Return `False` if validation or extraction fails; because pre-validation precedes all writes, no archive content is written if validation fails, and no member ever escapes `dest_path`.
END_PLAN
